info.name: Microsoft Windows 10 Windows Background Tasks Accelerometer Scheduled Notifications API
Microsoft Windows 10 List scheduled toast notifications

items.docs: Retrieves the list of scheduled toast notifications pending delivery. Uses the ToastNotifier.GetScheduledToastNotifications method.

info.name: Microsoft Windows 10 Schedule a toast notification

items.docs: Schedules a toast notification for future delivery using the ScheduledToastNotification class. The notification will be displayed at the specified delivery time and can optionally recur at a specified interval.
